# Home Assistant Dashboard Cards v1.5.0

Repository-level HACS release containing the latest versions of every bundled dashboard card.

## Included cards

- Chameleon Weather Card v1.2.2
- Worldclock Sun Card v1.4.3
- Expander Scroll Card v1.2.6
- TeamSpeak 3 Card v1.0.0
- Earthquake Alert Card v1.0.0

## Chameleon fix

- Bundles all chameleon and weather artwork in the HACS distribution.
- Adds the card version to local artwork URLs so companion apps cannot reuse cached missing-image responses from older installations.
- Versions the Chameleon module import as `chameleon-weather-card.js?v=1.2.2`.

## Packaging

This is the first repository-wide semantic release. HACS installs this repository as one frontend package, so future HACS updates will use repository-level `vX.Y.Z` releases instead of component-prefixed releases.

## Upgrade

Refresh HACS, then update **Home Assistant Dashboard Cards** to v1.5.0 and reload the dashboard.
